in_marathi.name: Pallaviya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pallaviya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pallava', meaning 'lotus'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a symbol of creation and is revered for its purity and beauty. The name Pallaviya is believed to bestow the qualities of purity, beauty, and grace upon the bearer.
